note: Frozen timings of two independent codes, for the paper performance figure. Measured on one desktop machine; absolute values are machine-dependent, the ratios much less so. Both solve the same problem: P(nu_mu -> nu_e) at L = 1300 km in constant matter of 3 g/cm^3, three flavors.

nufast_lbl.how: timed inside C++, best of five runs, N_Newton = 0 (its default); no Python involved

nusquids.how: timed through the Python interface, best of three runs, multiple-energy mode, rel and abs error 1e-12; includes constructing the solver and reading the results back
